main_argument_chains.claim: A numerical convection-diffusion model is more physically expressive than the steady or analytical baselines, while PID and distributed input provide the implementable strategy.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: State the nominal parameters, proxy metrics, control assumptions, and missing empirical validation before transfer.

main_argument_chains.claim: Uniformity requires a spatially distributed input, not only average-temperature control.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Use field evidence alongside average error and describe the distribution mechanism.

main_argument_chains.claim: Sensitivity advice is conditional on one-factor nominal perturbations.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Preserve held-fixed assumptions and do not call directional plots globally robust.
